title: Vehicle occupant health monitoring application
abstract: An example operation includes one or more of accessing, by an application providing assistance to a vehicle, sensor data associated with an environment inside and outside of a vehicle and profile data associated with a vehicle occupant, determining, by the application, an initial condition of the vehicle occupant based on the sensor data and the profile data, responsive to the initial condition being above a health condition threshold, accessing, by the application, health data associated with the vehicle occupant from a mobile device, determining, by the application, an updated condition of the vehicle occupant based on the health data, creating, by the application, an alert to notify the occupant based on the updated condition and one or more current driving conditions of the vehicle identified by the sensor data, and performing, by the vehicle, one or more vehicle actions based on the alert and the one or more current driving conditions.

title: Systems and methods for active road surface maintenance with cloud-based mobility digital twin
abstract: An active road surface maintenance system and method developed for connected vehicles with the aid of a mobility digital twin (MDT) framework. A method performed in a cloud-based digital space includes receiving data regarding a physical object from a physical space connected to a vehicle. The method also includes processing the data using machine learning to model road surface conditions, in which respective penalty values are assigned to corresponding road surfaces, a respective penalty value being higher the lower a condition of the corresponding road surface. The method also includes deriving instructions based on the modeled road surface conditions and the respective penalty values to guide actuation of the vehicle along a trajectory. The method further includes transmitting the instructions to the physical space connected to the vehicle to guide actuation of the vehicle.

title: Virtual-actual vehicle simulation method and system based on digital twin and electronic equipment
abstract: The application discloses a virtual-actual vehicle simulation method, a system and electronic equipment based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining first real state information used for representing the vehicle state of a real vehicle and first virtual state information used for representing the vehicle state of a virtual vehicle; the method comprises the steps of predicting the next vehicle state of a real vehicle based on first real state information and first virtual state information to generate a first prediction result, predicting the next vehicle state of a virtual vehicle to generate a second prediction result, adjusting the first real state information based on the first prediction result to generate corresponding second real state information, adjusting the first virtual state information based on the second prediction result to generate corresponding second virtual state information, and sending the second real state information to the virtual vehicle and the second virtual state information to the real vehicle. The method can realize the accurate simulation of the virtual vehicle to the real vehicle by utilizing the digital twin technology.

title: Methods for designing broadband noise and vibration absorbing meta-structures
abstract: A method includes defining a design domain for a meta-element configured to be attached to an edge of thin wall structure with an arbitrary boundary condition, and executing a topological optimization process on the design domain and providing a topology optimized shape for the meta-element. The topological optimization process includes an objective function that minimizes a reflection coefficient of flexural waves in the audible frequency range propagating towards and impinging the meta-element.

title: Automatic driving test method and system based on data twinning
abstract: The application discloses an automatic driving test method and system based on data twinning, wherein the method comprises the steps of forming a simulated traffic environment through a digital twinning simulation platform, simulating a simulated traffic participant and a simulated vehicle to be tested which are positioned in the simulated traffic environment, detecting the simulated traffic environment and the simulated vehicle to be tested through sensors of the simulated vehicle to be tested, obtaining detection data, sending an automatic driving instruction to the simulated vehicle to be tested through an automatic driving system based on the detection data, controlling the simulated vehicle to be tested to run in the simulated traffic environment, determining a collision intensity parameter of the collision accident based on impulse of the simulated vehicle to be tested under the condition that the simulated vehicle to be tested has the collision accident, wherein the collision intensity parameter is used for representing the severity of loss caused by the collision accident, and obtaining a test result based on the collision intensity parameter. The test result can more objectively and truly reflect the drivability of the automatic driving system.

title: Systems and methods for online monitoring using a neural model by an automated vehicle
abstract: Systems, methods, and other embodiments described herein relate to estimating reachable states for a vehicle using a neural model. In one embodiment, a method includes generating an unverified command by a first controller and a safety command by a second controller for a projected path by an automated driving system (ADS) associated with a vehicle. The method also includes estimating reachable states by a neural network (NN) model that uses the unverified command and an initial condition for the vehicle, the reachable states representing positions and orientations for the vehicle within a bounded time and a state space associated with the initial condition and the projected path. The method also includes, upon determining that the reachable states satisfy collision criteria, executing by the vehicle a maneuver with the safety command for the projected path and generating subsequent commands using vehicle data from the first controller and the second controller.

title: Systems and methods for verifying vehicle data
abstract: Systems and methods for verifying vehicle data are disclosed. In one aspect, a method includes clustering a plurality of vehicle types into a plurality of vehicle clusters based at least in part on vehicle characteristics, receiving vehicle data from a vehicle, assigning the vehicle to an individual vehicle cluster of the vehicle clusters, determining one or more digital twins also assigned to the individual cluster, comparing the vehicle data of the vehicle with vehicle data associated with the one or more digital twins, verifying the vehicle data when there is no discrepancy between the vehicle data of the vehicle and the vehicle data associated with the one or more digital twins, and adjusting the vehicle data when there is a discrepancy between the vehicle data of the vehicle and the vehicle data associated with the one or more digital twins.

title: Systems, methods, and vehicles for correcting driving behavior of a driver of a vehicle
abstract: Systems, methods, and vehicles for correcting driving behavior of a driver of a vehicle are provided. The systems include a controller programmed to identify a repetitive movement pattern of a driver of a vehicle at a predetermined location based on accumulated driving data of the vehicle, implement digital twin simulation of the vehicle using the repetitive movement pattern and the digital twin simulation of another object to identify a potential conflict between the vehicle and the another object, and inform the driver of the vehicle about predetermined driving behavior in response to identifying the potential conflict.

title: Method for managing logistics area, system for managing logistics area, and program
abstract: To provide a method for managing a logistics area, a system for managing a logistics area, and a program which use a simulation to manage a logistics area having a work line formed of a plurality of work subjects and can easily point out where a work subject which is not working as simulated is in a work space and how the work subject deviates from the simulation.SOLUTION: In a management system 100, a display device 130 simulates, using a digital twin simulator 110, a work space for a plurality of work subjects to work and monitors the actual motions of each work body in the work space. After that, the display device displays each of the plurality of work subjects on a screen of a display terminal 150 (140) simulating the work space as a heat map of which a color is changed according to a degree of deviation between motions simulated using the digital twin simulator and the monitored actual motions.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Logistics area management method and management system, and computer-readable recording medium
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method and a system for managing a physical distribution area, and a computer-readable recording medium, which can easily grasp where a work body that does not operate in accordance with a simulation is in a work space and how far from the simulation the physical distribution area is managed by using the simulation in the physical distribution area having a work line composed of a plurality of work bodies. A working space in which a plurality of working bodies are worked is simulated using digital twinning, and actual movements of the respective working bodies of the plurality of working bodies in the working space are monitored. On the screen simulating the working space, each of the plurality of working subjects is displayed with a heat map whose color is changed according to the magnitude of the deviation between the motion simulated by using digital twinning and the monitored actual motion.

title: Proactive vehicle maintenance scheduling based on digital twin simulations
abstract: The disclosure includes embodiments for proactive vehicle maintenance scheduling based on one or more digital twin simulations. A method includes generating a digital twin of a vehicle. The method includes receiving digital data recorded by a sensor and describing the vehicle as it exists in a real-world and one or more historical journeys of the vehicle in the real-world. The method includes updating the digital twin of the vehicle based on the digital data describing the vehicle so that the digital twin is consistent with a condition of the vehicle as it exists in the real-world. The method includes executing a simulation based on the digital twin and the one or more historical journeys. The method includes estimating a component of the vehicle that fails at a future time based on the simulation. The method includes scheduling a reservation to repair the component before the future time.
